remarks: Welcome to Indian River Green! This turnkey condo is located in a private community of 20 townhouses. Large wrap around entry porch leads into a spacious sunlit entry foyer complete with new white washed weathered oak floors. Newly updated Powder Room with laundry and recently purchased washer/dryer. Open floor plan featuring beautiful renovated white Kitchen that is bright with stainless steel appliances. The breakfast area is perfect to 'work from home'. The Dining area is nestled between the open kitchen & spacious living room with cozy gas fireplace with sliding doors that leads to a private flagstone patio and backyard. Enjoy views of the mature landscaping. The vaulted sun-filled stairway leads to two ensuite Bedrooms on the 2nd floor. The Primary bedroom features vaulted ceiling with dressing area has generous closets as well as a beautifully renovated primary bath with tankless water heater.  Sliding glass doors to priv deck where you can sip your morning coffee while gazing at nature. Second Bedroom with cathedral ceiling and skylight has a newly renovated bath. Pull down attic for even more storage. Attached garage with lots of storage. Enjoy meeting new neighbors while sipping the beverage of your choice sitting on the front porch.  Commuters Dream! It is a 5 minute walk to the Westport train station and walking distance to a variety of great restaurants.  Create many wonderful memories in your beautiful new home and enjoy all that Westport has to offer.
